name: Zinedine Zidane
scopeNote: Real Madrid first-team spells 2016-18 (three Champions Leagues) and 2019-21 (La Liga 2020). Style terms used by sources: 4-3-3 with the BBC, then a 'four-diamond-two' (Coaches' Voice) / 4-3-1-2 (The Ringer) with Isco as number 10 in 2017/18; Kroos-Modric-Casemiro midfield; a flexible, man-management-led approach rather than a pressing identity. Several sources (The Ringer, Gulf News) frame him as a manager of egos more than a tactician, which is partly contested by Coaches' Voice and Spielverlagerung match studies (e.g. man-marking scheme in the Dec 2017 Clasico). Exact day-level dates of the spells come from general knowledge, not from a mined page (first match 2016-01-09 is confirmed by the Spielverlagerung digest). No set-piece source found. France (appointed 2026-07-28 per Al Jazeera) is excluded as context; the brief said the appointment was in November 2026 but the source dates it 28 July 2026, with the first matches in September-October 2026. Assistant-year dates (2013-06 to 2014-06) are partial because the day is not sourced.

openQuestions: Exact day dates of the Real Madrid spells (2016-01-04 appointment, 2018-05-31 resignation, 2019-03-11 return, 2021-05-27 departure) are from general knowledge and not verified in a mined page.
Formation label disagreement: 4-3-1-2 (The Ringer), 'four-diamond-two' (Coaches' Voice), 4-4-2 diamond (blogs).

Pressing identity: Coaches' Voice says Real pressed 'intensely and as often' in a unit of five; therealchamps says low block with simple counter-pressing; WFI 2018 says counter-pressing collapsed in 2017/18. Sources disagree on its extent.

The Ringer says Zidane 'has not even acknowledged the question' of opponents abandoning man-marking, contradicting the Coaches' Voice/Spielverlagerung picture of in-game adjustment; the Dec 2017 Clasico shows an adjustment that backfired.
Some quotes on freedom given to players and the 'Juanito spirit' come from fan or blog sources (therealchamps); the Ronaldo quote on empathy dates from January 2016 and compares Zidane with Benitez.
Excluded France spell: the brief said the date is November 2026; Al Jazeera dates the appointment 28 July 2026 (first matches September-October 2026). France 2026 not assessed tactically.
Set-pieces: no source found. therealchamps.com is a fan site and is labelled tier C although it may be nearer D.
